question: What was the first charge capacity of the NMC622 recovered from cathode scraps by solvent-based separation?
rendered:
Document: "Sustainable Direct Recycling of Lithium-Ion Batteries via Solvent Recovery of Electrode Materials"

The first charge capacity of the NMC622 recovered from cathode scraps by EG-based separation was not found in this document. However, it was found in the other document:

Document: "Sustainable recycling of cathode scraps via Cyrene-based separation"

The first charge capacities for the baseline and recovered NMC622 were 205.6 and 194.0 mAh/g, respectively.
